newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: JOHNNIC BUYS STAKE IN GALLAGHER.
newsitem.headline: JOHNNIC BUYS STAKE IN GALLAGHER.

text.p: Johnnies Industrial Corp Ltd has bought 14.9 million shares in Gallagher Estate Holdings Ltd, representing around 34.75 percent of the firm, from Riccia Finance Proprietary Ltd (Ricfin), Gallagher said on Wednesday.
Ricfin is a wholly owned subsidiary of Johnnic and Riccia Group Holdings (Pty) Ltd.
No exact price was given in the brief announcement.
Gallagher said this reduced Riccia Group Holdings' (RGH) share to less than 35 percent of the issued share capital of Gallagher.
The sale was completed on April 4.

In a cautionary announcement on March 7 shareholders were advised that RGH had acquired additional shares at 60 cents per share, increasing its holding to over 50 percent of the issued share capital in Gallagher.
RGH also said then that it was in the process of negotiating the disposal of that controlling interest.
